jobs.name: world
jobs.prompt: Wide cheerful cartoon world background illustration for a friendly desktop app, flat vector style with bold clean shapes, soft cel shading and thick dark espresso-brown outlines. A sunny happy shiba inu village: rolling golden-yellow and warm lime-green hills across the lower half, cozy little cottages with orange and red roofs and round windows, a few cute wooden doghouses with golden roofs, round fluffy trees in yellow-green and golden autumn tones, sunflowers, a winding cream dirt path, tiny fences and a little bridge over a blue stream. Upper half is a bright warm sky gradient from soft butter yellow near the horizon to light cream-sky blue at the top, with a big smiling cartoon sun in the upper left. Lots of warm yellow and gold everywhere, very lively and joyful, detailed but tidy. No text, no characters, no watermark.
